items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury considered a 3-to-4-week recovery by doctors; he is out for Monday night vs. Eagles.
items.why: Grade 2 hamstring confirmed by league sources
items.implication: Bears likely to third-string or Bagent if cleared; major downgrade to CHI pass catchers short-term

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua doubtful for SNF at Denver with groin injury impacting explosiveness; functionally can play but not at full explosiveness. Short-term, possible return next week vs Eagles; surgery not expected.
items.why: Groin limiting explosiveness per league sources
items.implication: Davante Adams clear WR1; Whittington elevated; monitor for Week 4

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot, Q) expected to play vs Bengals; back after one week plantar fasciitis.
Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder, Q) expected to play vs Bengals.
items.implication: Full lead role with Dowdle OUT; high-volume RB2/flex

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring, Q) true pregame workout/GTD vs Cowboys; team not counting on him playing though he will push.
items.implication: If OUT, Ravens WR depth elevated; monitor inactives closely

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (hip, Q) good to go / plans to play vs Arizona.
items.why: Hip; plans to play per source
items.implication: Start with confidence; Levitan also projecting IN

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled out second straight week (hamstring); decent chance to return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Schultz elevated target share (~28-30%); other HOU WRs desperation
items.opportunity: TE/WR target share with Collins absent

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith officially off injury report and good to go for MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.implication: Full go; no reason to sit in fantasy

items.text: Projecting Brock Bowers (knee, Q) IN for Raiders; big DFS implications on main slate. Clarity hoped early on Flowers/Moore/Mitchell.
items.why: Knee post-meniscus; practice plan DNP Friday but optimistic reports
items.implication: Elite TE1 if active; start over most options

items.text: Sunday injuries summary: IN include Dobbins/Harvey/Nabers/Etienne/Price/Darnold etc; Q Bowers/Flowers/Evans/Coker/Moore/Warren/Pittman; D Nacua; OUT Daniels/Dart/Collins/Dowdle/Pierce/Brooks/Njoku/Kolar/Coleman etc.
items.implication: Clear beneficiaries: Warren full with Dowdle out; Hubbard lead post-Brooks; Schultz post-Collins; reverse if unexpected INs

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% target share last week with Collins out; IND allows 4th-most yards to TEs.
items.implication: Strong TE1/stream with Collins OUT again

items.text: With Nico Collins out last week, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% of routes and team-high 28% target share; faces Colts allowing 4th-most TE yards.
items.implication: Start Schultz confidently while Collins out

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop, DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games, RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: only 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble last week; JAX allows just 55 rush ypg to RBs (3.2 YPC).
items.why: Role loss + tough matchup; Henderson led post-fumble
items.implication: Sit/flex down; Henderson more appealing but still ranks Stevenson ahead slightly

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
items.conflict: ETR IN vs Berry role concern

items.text: After Stevenson fumble Q1 last week, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but ranks Stevenson ahead W3.
items.implication: Henderson stash/handcuff rising; monitor for lead
